title: 第六十一章 皮卡丘森林第六十章 大桥上的暧昧
content_zh:
几天下来，芽衣一直在介怀，对林萧不理不睬，晚上睡觉也是钻到娜姿的帐篷中和娜姿挤在一起。
无奈之下林萧只发动了，毛爷爷长征时那种不缺不饶，永不放弃的精神，在林萧死缠烂打、连哄带骗之下才让芽衣平息怒火。
这天，三人来到一座森林前，林萧拿出地图看了起来，良久惊呼道：“芽衣你有福了，这里叫做皮卡丘森林，里面有很多皮卡丘哦！”
“真的？”芽衣顿时大喜，一直以来她都想要收服一直皮卡丘，像小智那样放在外面溜达，而起皮卡丘的样子够萌、很可爱，是女孩子都会喜欢，只是之前一直没有找到合适的机会，如今遇上了怎么能错过。
“不过这么大的森林里，想找到皮卡丘可不容易.....”惊喜过头的芽衣有点泄气，想到在大森林里慢慢寻找皮卡丘，时间久了绝对会让人崩溃。
这傻妞还真是笨的可以，林萧无奈的摇摇头，竟然将身边最大的雷达都忘记了。有超能女王娜姿的存在，寻找到皮卡丘不难，林萧蛋疼的是芽衣怎么收服皮卡丘？她的藤藤蛇从来没有训练过，在野生区收服的三只伊布同样如此，难不成在找到皮卡丘以后打感情牌？
“有娜姿的存在你害怕找不到皮卡丘，”林萧对芽衣提醒到，“不过我看你应该先想一想应该怎么收服皮卡丘，你的小精灵可都是没有训练过的，战斗力充其量只有5点。”
说来奇怪，林萧一直搞不懂芽衣在野生原野区是怎么将伊布收服的，就凭藤藤蛇那渣滓一样的5点战斗力？
芽衣懊恼的一拍脑门，高兴道：“我怎么把娜姿姐姐给忘了，至于该怎么收服皮卡丘那是我自己事，用不着你操心，你以为谁都和你一样就知道战斗！”说完不忘对林萧轻哼一声。
真是好心没好报，林萧很无语的想到。
自从那天在大桥上发生那事以后，娜姿看林萧的眼神有些闪躲，一直都不愿意和林萧独处，搞得林萧郁闷不以，我又不会强，暴你，用得着这样么？
在娜姿的超强精神力下，皮卡丘所在的地方很快就被找到。
收回超能力，娜姿深深的吸了两口气，毕竟大范围使用超能力探查消耗很大，“在森林的东边，我们想要过去恐怕要走几个小时。”
“不就几个小时的路程吗？小意思而已。”芽衣气质高昂的带头走在前面，看来不抓到皮卡丘芽衣誓不罢休了。
几个小时还是小意思？你妹的这是森林里，连小路都没有，你以为是走大马路？
林萧很无语，但还是快步跟上芽衣，森林里可不止皮卡丘一种小精灵，玩意蹦跶出一些攻击性强的玩意伤到、吓到芽衣可就不好了。
“呜~~~”还不到一个小时，芽衣就已经气喘嘘嘘，撅着小嘴开始抱怨起来，“没事干嘛长那么多树藤，弄得人家没都发走了，好讨厌......”
林萧看着芽衣撅起可以挂油壶的小嘴，很无奈，走到她身前弯下腰，说道：“就知道逞强，这下尝到滋味了吧？上来我背你过去。”
“嘿嘿！”芽衣调皮的吐吐小香舌，趴在林萧的背上，“还是老公最好了，来，这是给你的奖励。”说完在林萧的脸上香了一口。
有困哪的时候老公最好，没困难的时候老公一边去抱着睡枕睡觉，哎~女人的心思猜不得，虽然芽衣还小，但大小还是个女人.....

林萧和芽衣没有注意到的是，身后的娜姿看着亲密的两人，眼里闪过一丝羡慕，不过很快被隐藏起来，默默无闻的跟在两人身后，不过是用超能力飘的，娜姿的体力比芽衣更单薄，不使用超能力的话早就趴下了。
没了芽衣这个小拖油瓶，三人的速度逐渐快了起来，两个小时候三人终于来到皮卡丘聚在一起的地方。
娜姿丝毫不顾形象，一屁股坐在地上，开始休息，几个小时的路程对她的消耗很大。
林萧同意如此，气喘嘘嘘的坐在一旁，森林里的到处是枝桠横生，每前进一步都很困难，更何况林萧还背着芽衣走了两个小时，此时坐在地上连小指母都懒得动一下。
三人不远处的一棵大树上，无数的皮卡丘和皮丘在上面四处乱跳，活泼可爱的身影惹得芽衣双眼冒起了小星星从背包里拿出小精灵食物放在不远处的地上，大声道：“皮卡丘、皮丘！快到这里来哦，姐姐这里有好多好多好吃的！”
说完主动退出一段距离，让众多皮卡丘和皮丘上来吃食物。
林萧已经被芽衣的捕捉方法惊得长大了嘴，久久合不拢，良久，苦笑一声，揉揉头道：“我应该早就想到的，这收服的皮卡丘的方法可真奇葩......”
不过林萧对这种方法表示很怀疑，先不说要多久才能让小精灵喜欢上自己和自己一起旅行，问题是现在的皮卡丘和皮丘不是一只，而是一群！数量不低于五十只。
芽衣有多少小精灵食物林萧可是知道得一清二楚，那点食物藐视只够五十来只皮卡丘个皮丘吃一顿，吃完以后怎么办？想用一顿食物就换到一直皮卡丘，这想法未免太扯淡.....
“皮！”“皮卡丘！”
皮丘和皮卡丘们听到芽衣的喊声，纷纷停了下来，望着她，看着芽衣将小精灵食物放在不远处的草地上，自己后退，有些着磨不定。
最终一只胆子稍大的皮丘，从树上跳下，吃了几口芽衣放下的食物后，眯着眼睛对着同伴大喊：“丘~~丘！”
在皮丘的呼唤下，感觉四周没有危险的皮卡丘和皮丘纷纷跳了下来，围着小精灵食物，吃的嗤嗤作响。
看着皮卡丘、皮丘们接受了自己的食物，芽衣高兴的眯起眼睛，随后在林萧身上打转了一圈。
芽衣的眼神让林萧心底冒起一股不详的预感，正想找个借口开溜，就被芽衣挡了下来。
挡在林萧身前的芽衣，扭捏的把玩着衣角，满脸布满不好意思的神色，轻声道：“那个.....老公~~我的小精灵食物不够了，皮卡丘和皮丘的数量太多。你看能不能用那些树果帮我多做一些呢？”
“纳尼！！！”林萧石化了，使劲掏掏耳朵，生怕自己听错了，紧张问道：“你是说我让为这五十多只皮丘和皮卡丘制作小精灵食物？是不是这样？”
在芽衣使劲上下晃动的小脑袋下，林萧喷出一口老血，晕死过去。
尼玛啊！这是五十只，不是五只好不好？真那么做回死人的！！林萧恨啊，恨自己为什么会制作小精灵食物，恨小智为什么要带着皮卡丘四处溜达，恨这座森林为什么会有这么多皮卡丘和皮丘！！

content_en:
For a few days, Yayi was always caring and ignored Lin Xiao. At night, she would go to Nazi's tent and squeeze together with her.
In desperation, Lin Xiao only mobilized. Mao Zedong's spirit of never giving up and never giving up during the Long March allowed Ya Yi to calm down his anger only after Lin Xiao pestered and coaxed her.
On this day, the three of them came to a forest. Lin Xiao took out a map and looked at it. He exclaimed for a long time: "Mei, you are lucky. This is called the Pikachu Forest, and there are many Pikachus in it!"
"Really?" Mei was immediately overjoyed. She had always wanted to conquer Pikachu and let him roam outside like Xiaozhi. Pikachu looked so cute and cute that girls would like it, but she had never found a suitable opportunity before. How could she miss it now that she had it.
"But it's not easy to find Pikachu in such a big forest..." Mei, who was overly surprised, was a little discouraged, thinking that slowly searching for Pikachu in a big forest would definitely make people collapse after a long time.
This silly girl is really stupid. Lin Xiao shook his head helplessly, forgetting about the biggest radar around him. With the existence of Super Queen Nazi, it is not difficult to find Pikachu. What bothers Lin Xiao is how can Mei Yi conquer Pikachu? Her Vine Snake has never been trained, and the same is true for the three Eevee she captured in the wild area. Is it possible that she is playing the emotional card after finding Pikachu?
"With Nazi's presence, you are afraid that you won't be able to find Pikachu," Lin Xiao reminded Mei, "But I think you should think about how to conquer Pikachu first. Your elves have not been trained, and their combat power is only 5 points at best."
Strangely enough, Lin Xiao has never understood how Mei Yi managed to subdue Eevee in the wild wilderness area, just with the scum-like 5-point combat power of the Vine Snake?
Mei Yi slapped her forehead in annoyance and said happily: "Why did I forget Sister Nazi? As for how to conquer Pikachu, that's my own business. You don't need to worry about it. You think everyone knows how to fight like you!" After saying this, he snorted to Lin Xiao.
Such good intentions are not rewarded, Lin Xiao thought speechlessly.
Ever since what happened on the bridge that day, Nazi looked at Lin Xiao with evasive eyes. She has been unwilling to be alone with Lin Xiao, which made Lin Xiao depressed. I can't rape you, is it necessary for me to be like this?
Thanks to Nazi's super mental power, Pikachu's location was quickly found.
Withdrawing her super power, Nazhi took two deep breaths. After all, using super power to explore in a large area is very expensive. "It's on the east side of the forest. If we want to go there, we may have to walk for several hours."
"Isn't it just a few hours away? It's just a joke." Mei Yi took the lead and walked in front with a high temperament. It seemed that Mei Yi would not give up until she caught Pikachu.
A few hours is still a trivial matter? Your sister, this is in the forest. There are no paths. Do you think we are taking the main road?
Lin Xiao was speechless, but he still quickly followed Mei Yi. There was more than just Pikachu in the forest. It would be bad if some aggressive things jumped out and hurt or scared Mei Yi.
"Ugh~~~" In less than an hour, Mei Yi was already out of breath, pouting her little mouth and starting to complain, "Why do you have so many vines growing for nothing? It makes everyone leave, it's so annoying..."
Lin Xiao looked at Yayi pouting her little mouth that could hang an oil can. He felt helpless. He walked to her and bent down, saying, "I know how to show off my strength. Have you tasted it now? Come on up and I will carry you over."
"Hey!" Yayi spit out her sweet tongue playfully and lay on Lin Xiao's back, "My husband is the best. Come on, this is your reward." After saying that, he took a sip on Lin Xiao's face.
My husband is the best when he is sleepy. When he is not in trouble, he hugs the pillow and sleeps. Alas, you can’t guess what a woman is thinking. Although Mei is still young, she is still a woman....
What Lin Xiao and Mei Yi didn't notice was that Nazi behind them looked at the two people who were so close, with a flash of envy in their eyes. However, it was quickly hidden, and she followed the two of them in obscurity, using her super power to float. Nazi's physical strength was weaker than Mei Yi's, and she would have fallen down long ago if she didn't use her super power.
Without Mei Yi as a dragster, the speed of the three of them gradually increased. After two hours, the three of them finally arrived at the place where Pikachu gathered.
Nazi didn't care about her image at all, sat down on the ground and started to rest. The few hours' journey took a lot of energy from her.
Lin Xiao agreed and sat aside panting. There were branches everywhere in the forest, making every step forward difficult. Not to mention that Lin Xiao had been carrying Mei Yi for two hours and was sitting on the ground, not even bothering to move his little finger.
On a big tree not far from the three of them, countless Pikachu and Pichu were jumping around. Their lively and cute figures made Mei's eyes sparkle. He took out the elf food from his backpack and placed it on the ground not far away. He said loudly: "Pikachu, Pichu! Come here quickly, sister, there are a lot of delicious food here!"
After saying that, he took the initiative to retreat a certain distance and let many Pikachu and Pichu come up to eat the food.
Lin Xiao was so shocked by Mei Yi's capture method that his mouth opened wide. He couldn't close it for a long time. After a long time, he smiled bitterly, rubbed his head and said, "I should have thought of it a long time ago. This method of subduing Pikachu is really weird..."
However, Lin Xiao expressed doubts about this method. Not to mention how long it would take for the elf to like him and travel with him. The problem is that now there is not one Pikachu and Pichu, but a group! The number is no less than fifty.
Lin Xiao knew exactly how much elf food Mei had. That little food was only enough for about fifty Pikachus and Pichus to eat. What would they do after eating? It's too ridiculous to think that one meal of food can be exchanged for a Pikachu all the way...
"Pi!" "Pikachu!"
When Pichu and Pikachu heard Mei's shout, they all stopped and looked at her. They watched Mei place the elf food on the grass not far away and then backed away, feeling a little uncertain.
Finally, a braver Pichu jumped down from the tree. After eating a few mouthfuls of the food Meiyi put down, he narrowed his eyes and shouted to his companions: "Qiu~~Qiu!"
At Pichu's call, Pikachu and Pichu, who felt that there was no danger around them, jumped down one after another and surrounded the elf food, eating.
Seeing Pikachu and Pichu accept their food, Mei narrowed her eyes happily, and then circled around Lin Xiao.
The look in Yai's eyes made Lin Xiao feel an ominous premonition in his heart. Just as he was about to find an excuse to escape, he was blocked by Yai.
Ya Yi, who was standing in front of Lin Xiao, played with the corners of his clothes, with an embarrassed look on his face, and said softly: "Um...husband~~ I don't have enough elf food, there are too many Pikachu and Pichu. Do you think you can use those tree fruits to make more for me?"
"Nani!!!" Lin Xiao was petrified, and he picked his ears hard. He was afraid that he heard wrongly, and asked nervously: "You mean I asked you to make elf food for these more than fifty Pichu and Pikachu? Is that right?"
Under Yayi's head shaking vigorously, Lin Xiao spurted out a mouthful of old blood and fainted.
Damn it! This is fifty, not five, okay? You really do that to bring back the dead! ! Lin Xiao hated it, hated why he made elf food, hated why Xiaozhi took Pikachu around, hated why there were so many Pikachu and Pichu in this forest! !
